blocks.text: Drunken idea to take employer’s car for a spin lands man in jail CEBU CITY, Philippines — A drunken idea to take his employer’s Multicab without permission out for a ride to clear his “liquor-fogged mind” cost a 29-year-old helper his job and likely spend quite some time in jail. This was after the the employer refused to accept his apology and vows to file a carnapping case against the worker.
